_comment: Which harness mode ids (and config option values) skip every approval, for sessions.allowFullAccess. acpmux (hub/start_mode.rs) and the cmux NEXT app (AgentPaneModeConfirmation.swift, checked by FullAccessModeRuleTests) both apply this rule. Fold an id first: lowercase it and drop every '-', '_' and space. A permission mode (session/set_mode, or the value of the mode config option) is full access unless its folded id is one of allowedModes and contains no marker, so a mode this list does not know is refused while the setting is off. Any other config option's value is full access when it contains a marker. allowedModes: Claude Code default, acceptEdits, plan, dontAsk and auto (a classifier still stops risky actions); the Codex bridge's ask, read-only and agent; codex-acp read-only and auto; Codex full-auto (sandboxed, asks to leave it); Gemini CLI default, autoEdit and plan. opencode's build is left out: opencode's own permissions can run every edit and command without asking.
